name: The Ordinary 100% Organic Cold - Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
description:
100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rosehip Seed Oil naturally hydrates skin to help address signs of aging by brightening and balancing uneven skin tone, supporting skin elasticity, and promoting supple, more radiant-looking skin. It’s made of 100% organic rosehip seed oil that is cold-pressed to retain its potency and is gentle enough for daily use.

Our Rose Hip Seed Oil is completely unrefined and imparts a natural scent partly due to its high omega fatty acid content. This scent is not an indication of rancidity.
